title: C Cross the Road
statementMd:
Cross the Road
     Input file:           standard input
     Output file:          standard output
     Time limit:           1 second
     Memory limit:         512 megabytes

You are about to cross the road, but an e-bike is speeding along it.
In the Cartesian plane, a road of width w extends infinitely in the x-direction and occupies the strip
0 ≤ y ≤ w. You start from the fixed point (0, 0) and want to reach any point on the upper boundary
y = w, while avoiding an e-bike on the road.
The e-bike’s body is represented by a line segment parallel to the x-axis. At time t = 0, its endpoints are
(x1 , yc ) and (x2 , yc ), where x1 < x2 . The e-bike moves with constant horizontal velocity u, so at time t
its endpoints are at (x1 + ut, yc ) and (x2 + ut, yc ).
You may move in any direction or wait, but your speed must never exceed v. Equivalently, for any two
times 0 ≤ t1 ≤ t2 , the Euclidean distance between your positions at those times must be at most v(t2 −t1 ).
At no time may you be on the e-bike’s segment except at its endpoints; touching either endpoint is allowed.
You start from (0, 0) at time t = 0. Find the minimum time needed to reach any point on y = w safely.
It can be shown that an answer always exists.

Input
The first line contains an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 2000), the number of test cases.
Each test case consists of one line containing six integers w, x1 , x2 , yc , u, v (2 ≤ w ≤ 4 × 104 ,
−4 × 104 ≤ x1 < x2 ≤ 4 × 104 , 1 ≤ yc ≤ w − 1, −4 × 104 ≤ u ≤ 4 × 104 , 1 ≤ v ≤ 4 × 104 ). Here,
w is the width of the road, (x1 , yc ) and (x2 , yc ) are the e-bike’s endpoints at time t = 0, u is the e-bike’s
horizontal velocity, and v is your maximum speed.

Output
For each test case, output one real number on a separate line: the minimum time needed to reach y = w
safely.
Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10−6 . More precisely,
                                                                                           |a−b|
for each value a you output and the corresponding reference value b, the requirement is max(1,|b|) ≤ 10−6 .

Example
             standard input                                     standard output
 3                                                  10.000000000
 10 100 110 5 3 1                                   5.286299648
 10 -2 2 1 1 2                                      10.250000000
 10 -2 2 1 -1 1

Note
The figure below shows the initial state (t = 0) of the second test case in the sample. The orange segment
represents the e-bike, and the blue point S = (0, 0) is your starting point. The arrow indicates the e-bike’s
direction of motion, with u = 1.

statementZhMd:
穿过马路
     输入文件：           标准输入
     输出文件：           标准输出
     时间限制：           1 秒
     内存限制：           512 MB

你正准备穿过马路，但一辆电动自行车正在路上疾驰。

在笛卡尔平面中，一条宽度为 w 的道路沿 x 方向无限延伸，占据区域 0 ≤ y ≤ w。你从固定点 (0, 0) 出发，希望在避开路上电动自行车的同时，到达上边界 y = w 上的任意一点。

电动自行车的车身用一条平行于 x 轴的线段表示。在时刻 t = 0，其两个端点分别为 (x1, yc) 和 (x2, yc)，其中 x1 < x2。电动自行车以恒定的水平速度 u 移动，因此在时刻 t，其两个端点分别位于 (x1 + ut, yc) 和 (x2 + ut, yc)。

你可以向任意方向移动，也可以等待，但你的速度始终不能超过 v。等价地，对于任意两个时刻 0 ≤ t1 ≤ t2，你在这两个时刻所在位置之间的欧几里得距离至多为 v(t2 − t1)。

在任何时刻，你都不能位于电动自行车线段上除端点以外的位置；允许接触任一端点。

你在时刻 t = 0 从 (0, 0) 出发。求安全到达 y = w 上任意一点所需的最短时间。

可以证明，答案总是存在。

输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 T (1 ≤ T ≤ 2000)，表示测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例占一行，包含六个整数 w, x1, x2, yc, u, v (2 ≤ w ≤ 4 × 10⁴, −4 × 10⁴ ≤ x1 < x2 ≤ 4 × 10⁴, 1 ≤ yc ≤ w − 1, −4 × 10⁴ ≤ u ≤ 4 × 10⁴, 1 ≤ v ≤ 4 × 10⁴)。其中，w 为道路的宽度，(x1, yc) 和 (x2, yc) 为电动自行车在时刻 t = 0 的两个端点，u 为电动自行车的水平速度，v 为你的最大速度。

输出格式

对于每个测试用例，在单独一行输出一个实数：安全到达 y = w 所需的最短时间。

如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10⁻⁶，则视为正确。更准确地说，对于你输出的每个值 a 及其对应的参考值 b，必须满足 |a−b| / max(1,|b|) ≤ 10⁻⁶。

样例

             标准输入                                     标准输出
 3                                                  10.000000000
 10 100 110 5 3 1                                   5.286299648
 10 -2 2 1 1 2                                      10.250000000
 10 -2 2 1 -1 1
